    AI Overview
    Top 2026 Easter egg hunts near Washington D.C./Northern Virginia include
    Green Meadows Farm (March 21-April 5), Capital One Center's hunt on April 4th, and several regional park events. Key, unique hunts feature underwater activities at Chinquapin Park (April 4) and a "Beeping" egg hunt for visually impaired children in Falmouth (March 29). 
    Top 2026 Easter Egg Hunt Events 
    • Green Meadows Farm (Ijamsville, MD): March 21-22, 28-29, & April 2-5. Features candy-filled eggs and a petting farm.
    • Capital One Center (Tysons, VA): April 4, 11 a.m. egg hunt at The Perch, featuring a petting zoo and color run.
    • Chinquapin Park Recreation Center (Alexandria, VA): April 4th Underwater Egg Hunt.
    • NOVA Wild (Vienna, VA): April 4-5, 11 a.m. and 1 p.m..
    • Clark’s Elioak Farm (Ellicott City, MD): Egg hunts March 28-29 & April 4-5.
    • Meadowlark Botanical Gardens (Vienna, VA): Ongoing through April 7.
    • City of Falls Church (Cherry Hill Park): April 4 event with crafts and the Easter Bunny. 
    Specialty Hunts 
    • Dog Egg Hunt (Fredericksburg, VA): March 27 at Maury Playground.
    • Egg-streme Teen Night Hunt (Fairfax, VA): April 2 at Historic Blenheim (ages 10-14).
    • Adventure Park at Virginia Aquarium (VA Beach): March 18–April 5 "Egg Hunt in the Trees". 
    Many locations, including Green Meadows Farm and City of Falls Church, advise booking in advance and arriving early for parking.
